C0210.title: Man in Xunwu Sentenced for Brushing and Fake Review Operations on Overseas Amazon Platform
C0210.summary: Between August 2023 and April 2024, a man surnamed Zhang operated a studio in Xunwu County, Jiangxi, taking orders via WeChat to provide brushing and fake review services for merchants on overseas Amazon platforms.
